description: This file implements the RemoveSource class, which handles the removal of a media source (specifically AUDIO type) in a GStreamer-based media playback system. It manages clearing buffers, updating context flags, and sending flush events to the GStreamer source element.

classes.name: RemoveSource
classes.description: A class responsible for removing a media source of type AUDIO from the media pipeline, including flushing the source element.

methods.name: RemoveSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoveSource object with context, client, gstWrapper, and media source type.

methods.name: ~RemoveSource
methods.description: Destructor that logs the completion of RemoveSource object lifecycle.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the removal of the media source by clearing buffers, updating flags, and sending flush events to the GStreamer source element.
